steps.title: P4c-2 falls look
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/falls_look.json at 1920x1080. A new 150 ft temperate forest map (seed 1234): a two-tier Tier step (Sculpt's Tier twice) with a straight waist river drawn from its top toward the camera along the grid, and a 13 m Raise hill east of it (an 8 m dome, its flank at 44 degrees at the steepest, a steep run of about 9 m; it stands clear of the river in screen space, since a hill between the camera and a stroke's path catches the pointer's ray) with an ankle stream drawn from its top down the flank toward the camera about 22 degrees off the grid (the angle where a grid-sampled crease saws), so P4c-1 plans two hillside falls. The carved ground is captured with the water hidden at home and at zoom 8 on each fall's foot (probes/falls.gd names them); the water shown once per fall for reference. Judge the ground: the rock lip, the face, the notch's side walls (P4c-2b: a channel width or two of rock, not a quarry), the plunge bowl, any sawtooth or hanging upper water.
